Redwood Lakeside

Villa in Bang Tao
HomeSaleRedwood Lakeside

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A lakeside villa enclave by Redwood Luxury near Bang Tao, with 3 and 4 bedroom villas on plots of 400 to 902 sqm. Four villa types (Palm, Orchid, Lotus, Lily) include single-storey and two-storey designs, each with a private pool. Heavy landscaping and a shuttle to local beach and shopping hubs are part of the offer.

Redwood Lakeside: key facts

  • Redwood Lakeside is a pool villa in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Redwood Luxury.
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 175–272 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿37,400,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (2.4 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Phuket International Airport (about 30 minutes); Bang Tao Beach (2.4 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (4.4 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (5.7 km, straight line).

Facilities & amenities

  • Playgrounds

  • Double-wall construction with thermal insulation
